Regular competitive Bundestag elections select the governing parliamentary coalition. Merz replaced Scholz after the 2025 election. Courts, the Bundesrat and parliamentary investigation constrain executive power.
Focused six-question reassessment: The Basic Law protects independent central banking and constructive parliamentary succession. Emergency primary lawmaking uses representative institutions rather than a sole chancellor; Article 115h extends electoral terms during a formally declared state of defence.
